runtime_compatibility.reason: Retain prior microbatch gradients in all_grad_tensors before the accumulation boundary

comparison_limitations: This RL run applies the recorded DeepSpeed gradient-accumulation compatibility correction.
The SFT baseline uses its existing fixed export; it was not retrained for this comparison.
Historical SFT training with the same DeepSpeed configuration may also have been affected. This comparison cannot isolate algorithm gains from changes in gradient-accumulation behavior.
Failed earlier attempts are not RL results and are excluded from all metric comparisons.

validation.perplexity_scope: Supervised answer tokens only; prompt and padding labels are masked

evaluation.metric_semantics: original SID-level; colliding item IDs indistinguishable
evaluation.interpretation: SID validity is enforced by catalog constraints; HR/NDCG measure ranking quality.

parent_sft.metric_semantics: Original SID-level matching. Item IDs sharing a SID are indistinguishable; coldness is based on item IDs, not SID strings.
parent_sft.interpretation: Shared catalog/metadata; every original test row has equal weight. No candidate filtering or row removal. Cold-group estimates may be based on a small number of targets.

recommendation.tie_rule: Retain parent SFT when validation NDCG@10 does not improve

protocol.metric_semantics: Original SID-level matching. Item IDs sharing a SID are indistinguishable; coldness is based on item IDs, not SID strings.

interpretation: HR@K equals Recall@K for one relevant target per test row.
Behavior-cold targets are item IDs absent from training histories and targets; SID aliases remain possible.
Cold results use the displayed row and hit counts; a few hits do not establish a reliable improvement.
Model recommendation uses complete validation NDCG@10. Final test comparison does not select a model.

expectation_assessment.summary: The selected RL model shows partial gains, but does not meet the combined improvement criterion.
expectation_assessment.summary_zh: 部分指标改善，但未满足验证、测试和召回率共同改善的标准。

definitions.improved: Validation and test NDCG@10 both increase, and test HR@10/HR@50 do not decrease.
definitions.mixed: Some primary metrics increase and others decrease or remain unchanged, without meeting improved.
definitions.not_improved: None of validation NDCG@10, test NDCG@10, test HR@10 and test HR@50 increases.
definitions.pending: Complete verified validation and both complete test evaluations are required for a conclusion.

evidence_boundaries: Only one training seed was evaluated. Changes are descriptive; repeated-seed uncertainty was not estimated.
The behavior-cold group has 147 test rows; one hit changes HR@50 by 0.680272 percentage points. A few hits do not establish a reliable cold-item gain.
